description: A PHP trait named EncryptionHelperTrait that provides utility methods for encryption functionalities, including retrieving a cryptographer instance and checking if encryption is enabled. It interacts with KeyHandler for key management and conditionally initializes a Cryptographer object.

methods.name: getCryptographer
methods.description: Returns an instance of Cryptographer if available, initializing it with a key from KeyHandler if necessary.

methods.name: encryptionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the cryptographer instance is properly initialized, indicating if encryption is enabled.
